Trading update | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Trading update Summary by AI BETA Close X Home REIT completed sales of its remaining 853 properties for gross proceeds of £138.8m and has placed all subsidiaries into creditors' voluntary liquidation to advance planning for any return of capital to shareholders. Based on the September 2026 run‑rate post-sales, annualised expenses excluding legal fees are £4.7m (down c. £2.1m versus the year ended 31 August 2026); Q3 general and administrative expenses (ex legal) were £0.8m (Q2 £1.5m) and legal costs were £0.5m (Q2 £1.2m). The Board is targeting further cost reductions to £2.0–£2.5m p.a., has served six‑month notice on the investment management agreement and will cut investment advisory fees to £120k/month from 29 Oct 2026 and £42k/month from 29 Jan 2027.
